# nutanix_subnet_v2 (Data Source)

Reads one Nutanix subnet through the Networking v4.3 API.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ext_id` (String) External UUID of the Nutanix subnet.

### Read-Only

- `bridge_name` (String)
- `cluster_reference` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `id` (String) Terraform identity, equal to the validated caller-supplied ext_id.
- `ip_config` (Attributes List) Dual-stack address configuration returned by Nutanix. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ip_config))
- `is_advanced_networking` (Boolean)
- `is_external` (Boolean)
- `is_nat_enabled` (Boolean)
- `name` (String)
- `network_id` (Number)
- `subnet_type` (String)
- `virtual_switch_reference` (String)
- `vpc_reference` (String)
